### Your Shield of Protection
Author: Cindi McMenamin
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/your-shield-of-protection-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 3:3
Points:
- Insensitive remarks, criticism, and unsolicited opinions can easily make us feel exposed, isolated, and inadequate.
- Believers do not have to sink into embarrassment or retaliate with sharp comebacks when attacked.
- God serves as an encircling shield that guards our hearts and lifts our bowed heads with divine confidence.
- Trusting that the Lord surrounds us with His protection and favor gives us strength to persevere on our path.
